name: Forecast-Error -> EMS Robustness Contract & Roadmap
primary_engineering_question: How does downstream EMS operational behavior (unmet load, diesel consumption, renewable curtailment, and SOC boundary integrity) change as a function of systematic forecast error in solar, wind, and demand when the frozen POLARIS closed-loop MPC is supplied with perturbed forecasts under identical hidden ground-truth actual trajectories?
implementation_scope_boundary: Implementation authorization permits construction and modification of D5 implementation code, D5-specific schemas or adapters that do not modify frozen system schemas, configuration, test infrastructure, and supporting documentation required to implement the frozen D5 contract. It does NOT authorize modification of frozen D5 contract, frozen EMS scientific/operational logic, frozen forecasting logic, frozen evaluator definitions, frozen D4 artifacts/governance, or locked historical research artifacts. Frozen system schemas (ForecastBundle, DispatchPlan, StationState) MUST NOT be modified.
system_schema_immutability_rule: Frozen system schemas, including system/schemas/forecast_bundle.py, system/schemas/dispatch_plan.py, and system/schemas/station_state.py, MUST NOT be modified. D5-specific validation structures, adapters, scenario representations, or metadata schemas may be added only where they do not alter the behavior, fields, validation rules, or semantics of frozen system schemas.
hidden_actual_trajectory_firewall: During implementation and implementation testing, hidden future actual trajectories MUST NOT be loaded or consumed as experimental inputs. Synthetic/mock actuals may be used solely to verify software interfaces, state transitions, evaluator wiring, or control flow. A real D5 experimental actual trajectory combined with a D5 perturbation scenario is sufficient to require D5 execution authorization.

two_world_causal_firewall.firewall_rule: Perturbation generator P inspects ONLY baseline 24h ForecastBundle F_t, predeclared parameters theta, deterministic metadata, and specified random seed. Inspection, access, or calibration against hidden ground-truth actuals before controller decision is strictly prohibited.
two_world_causal_firewall.exogenous_input_stream_provenance: At corresponding MPC decision points, paired control and perturbed executions must use the same predeclared exogenous observation/input provenance for baseline ForecastBundle generation.

interval_scaling_semantics.formula: L' = gamma * L, P' = gamma * P, U' = gamma * U
interval_scaling_semantics.rule: For gamma >= 0, preserves lower <= point <= upper by construction. Invalid values are REJECTED AS INVALID without silent clamping or repair.

closed_loop_mpc_semantics.simulation_duration_iterations: For D5-1 through D5-5: exactly N=24 closed-loop iterations. For D5-6: exactly N=168 closed-loop iterations. These durations are frozen contract boundaries and MUST NOT be changed during implementation or execution.
closed_loop_mpc_semantics.perturbation_rule: Reapplied independently to newly generated 24h baseline ForecastBundle at each MPC decision point.

gate_fixture_immutability: D5-1 through D5-6 scenario definitions are frozen contract inputs. Antigravity MUST NOT alter perturbation factors, scenario composition, horizon, iteration count, persistence, evaluation definitions, or causality rules.

scenario_matrix.name: Solar Underprediction
scenario_matrix.purpose: Tests EMS response when available solar generation is systematically underrepresented in the forecast.

scenario_matrix.name: Solar Overprediction Sensitivity
scenario_matrix.purpose: Tests EMS response when available solar generation is systematically overrepresented in the forecast.

scenario_matrix.name: Wind Underprediction
scenario_matrix.purpose: Tests EMS response when available wind generation is systematically underrepresented in the forecast.

scenario_matrix.name: Wind Overprediction
scenario_matrix.purpose: Tests EMS response when available wind generation is systematically overrepresented in the forecast.

scenario_matrix.name: Demand Overprediction
scenario_matrix.purpose: Tests EMS response when station demand is systematically overrepresented in the forecast.

scenario_matrix.name: Compound Over-Optimistic Forecast Stress
scenario_matrix.purpose: Tests a deliberately specified compound stress condition in which renewable generation is overpredicted and demand is underpredicted.

implementation_completion_and_review_bou.after_review_state: D5 IMPLEMENTATION = REVIEWED / EXECUTION NOT AUTHORIZED
implementation_completion_and_review_bou.execution_authorization_rule: A separate explicit D5 EXECUTION AUTHORIZATION is required before any D5 experimental scenario is executed.
implementation_completion_and_review_bou.experimental_execution_trigger: A test that executes the frozen EMS using a D5 experimental scenario against an experimental actual trajectory constitutes D5 experimental execution, regardless of whether it is invoked through a test, script, integration test, smoke test, or diagnostic command.
implementation_completion_and_review_bou.supporting_documentation_boundary: New implementation documentation may be created where required to implement or review D5. Existing frozen governance/checkpoint artifacts MUST NOT be rewritten, amended, or regenerated during implementation merely for documentation convenience. This governance cleanup is an explicitly authorized controlled revision of the current D5 contract/checkpoint provenance artifacts. After this cleanup is completed and the revised artifacts are frozen, they become authoritative and MUST NOT be amended or rewritten for implementation convenience. Any future implementation dependency requiring modification of a frozen governance/checkpoint artifact is a STOP-and-report condition.
implementation_completion_and_review_bou.implementation_test_firewall: Implementation-level tests may verify software/contract correctness using isolated synthetic/mock inputs, but MUST NOT execute D5-1 through D5-6, consume D5 experimental actual trajectories, generate empirical EMS forecast-error response metrics, or perform baseline-versus-perturbed experimental comparisons.
